title: Preserve lyrics authored directly on beats
scope: Add a distinct destination for GPIF Beat.Lyrics and retain line order through public edits and export.
acceptance: A beat with two lyric lines and separate FreeText retains all three values.
Repeated definitions produce independent lyric occurrences at the correct beat/staff.
The independent consumer sees the exact ordered beat lyrics, including empty and Unicode lines.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Defines the optional GPIF beat Lyrics element and ordered Line payloads.
Copies every source occurrence into independent public Beat.Lyrics storage.
Emits absent, authored-empty, and populated beat lyric elements exactly.
Covers two ordered lines including an empty line and Unicode, separate FreeText, nil versus empty elements, reused definition ownership, public edits, exact wire output, and Go reimport.
Covers permissive and strict diagnostics for unknown content nested in Beat.Lyrics.
Pinned AlphaTab verifies exact source and edited-output lyric facts at each track, staff, bar, voice, and beat location.
Reproduced at tracks[0].staves[0].bars[9].voices[0].beats[0].lyrics. Source and target values are stored in probe_comparison.

Checked two ordered lyric lines including empty/Unicode text alongside independent FreeText, nil versus authored empty elements, reused-definition ownership across staffs, parsed edits, and exact consumer lyrics. Score and track lyric assignment remain separate contracts.

resolution: Added Beat.Lyrics as the direct, documented authority for ordered beat-scoped GPIF lines. Import clones every referenced definition into independent occurrence storage; nil means absent while a non-nil empty slice preserves an authored empty Lyrics element. GP8 export writes that exact distinction and keeps Beat.Text, Track.Lyrics, and Song.Lyrics independent. Focused tests cover ordered empty and Unicode lines, separate FreeText, multi-staff reused definitions, post-parse edits, malformed nested syntax, exact GPIF, Go reimport, and pinned AlphaTab consumption. The refreshed authored-source probe preserves 6/6 beat-lyrics.gp facts and 1812/1812 facts in each GP7 and GP8 faulty fixture; legacy score/track lyric application remains excluded under ticket #98.
